# simulation tools

[Project home](../../README.md) · [Folder guide](../../Documentation/project_structure.md)

Commands for running the model, playing its saved movement, exporting figures and preparing documentation. The root run.py is the normal entry point.

`Code/simulation_tools`

| File or folder | Purpose and units |
| --- | --- |
| [__init__.py](__init__.py) | Run, visualize and export the fully forward model. |
| [build_documentation_website.py](build_documentation_website.py) | Package the existing HTML documentation for GitHub Pages. |
| [create_muscle_model_guide.py](create_muscle_model_guide.py) | Build the illustrated muscle guide from the current editable configuration. |
| [create_release_figures.py](create_release_figures.py) | Create readable late-trial comparison figures from saved forward results. |
| [generate_folder_guides.py](generate_folder_guides.py) | Build navigable folder guides and readable source listings from public files. |
| [interactive_comparison.js](interactive_comparison.js) | interactive comparison. |
| [render_walking_video.py](render_walking_video.py) | Render a video of the cat from saved forward-dynamics states. |
| [run_forward_simulation.py](run_forward_simulation.py) | Run the coupled forward model from editable files. |
| [view_walking_simulation.py](view_walking_simulation.py) | Inspect an already computed forward run; never solve or alter its motion. |
